summary: End-to-end tested Compass Planning platform Admin Console. All 8 requested flows passed via Playwright on the live preview URL: admin TOTP login → /admin, Overview stat cards + Current status, all 6 sidebar nav links load their pages (admin-overview, admin-accounts, admin-billing, admin-announcements, admin-tickets, admin-status), account suspend/reactivate round-trip (restored to active), Chase MOCK billing badge 'chase · mock mode' + Mark paid flipped the open Solo invoice to paid (subs_active went 2→3), announcement create (ann-active defaulted OFF but we toggled it ON before posting), ticket create + status change to resolved persisted, outage status post surfaced in advisor's notice-banner on /dashboard, advisor blocked from /admin (redirects to /dashboard) and admin on /dashboard redirected to /admin. Backend also curl-verified: /api/admin/overview returns full payload for admin, 403 for advisor, /api/notices requires auth.

minor.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed — no delete endpoint for tickets. Admin can only change status to resolved. Not blocking, but inconsistent with announcements which support DELETE.

ui_bugs.issue: ann-active toggle defaults to OFF when creating a new announcement. The task description implied it should be on by default. First attempt created an inactive announcement that would NOT reach users. Low-priority UX nit.

issues: After resolving an outage, the card still shows the resolved outage title with an 'operational' badge. Reads as if the outage is active but tagged operational. Consider showing a generic 'All systems operational' message when no unresolved outage exists.

action_items: (LOW) Default the 'Active' toggle to ON for new announcements, or add a hint that announcements must be marked active to be published.
(LOW) Overview 'Current status' card should fall back to a generic operational message when no unresolved outage exists.
(OPTIONAL) Add DELETE /api/admin/tickets/{id} for symmetry with announcements.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend tier gate works correctly: non-admin → 403 on /api/admin/overview; /api/notices requires auth (401 unauth).
Frontend route guard works both directions: non-admin visiting /admin → /dashboard, admin visiting /dashboard → /admin.
Chase mock gateway is clearly labelled 'chase · mock mode' in UI — no risk of mistaking for real payments.

Suspended-user login block is in auth.py — tested indirectly by suspend→reactivate round-trip; could add an isolated test confirming login returns 403 while suspended (skipped to avoid locking a demo account).

All suspensions reverted — suspended=0. Billing side-effect: seeded Solo invoice is now 'paid' and its subscription is 'active' (expected per Mark paid flow). Overview final state: suspended=0, tickets_open=2 (seeded), subscriptions_active=3.

Login flow via browser requires clicking [data-testid=login-submit] specifically — avoid button:has-text('Sign In') because it matches the tab-signin pill first. MFA code input is the first input inside [data-testid=mfa-form]. The seeded Solo invoice has already been marked paid (no more open invoices to test 'Mark paid' with unless seed is re-run). A resolved 'TEST Ticket Subject XYZ' is left in the ticket list (not deletable via API).
